description: This header file declares functions related to HTTP status codes, methods, and versions, providing string conversion utilities and mappings for a web server library.

methods.name: li_http_status_string
methods.description: Returns the description for a given HTTP status code and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_method_from_string
methods.description: Returns the liHttpMethod enum entry matching the given string.

methods.name: li_http_method_string
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method as a string and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_version_string
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version as a string and sets the length of the string.

methods.name: li_http_status_to_str
methods.description: Converts a given HTTP status code to a 3-character string.
